question.text: The ICAI SIAB acts as the SRO for Social Impact Assessors. Which body among the following is NOT the SRO for SIAs?

answer.text: ICAI SIAB — the body referenced in the SEBI SIA framework
ICMAI (Institute of Cost Accountants of India)

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the exam contract, only ICAI SIAB is the notified SRO. ICMAI is NOT the SRO for SIAs, though cost accountants can be empanelled individually subject to criteria. Chapter 6 (referenced by Ch 7) confirms this. The Trap: Cost accountants qualify for SIA empanellment under ICAI SIAB but the SRO body itself is ICAI, not ICMAI. Candidates often confuse the two chartered-body acronyms. Cross-Exam Context: SRO structure is tested in III-A/III-C Compliance (AMFI for MF distributors, FIMMDA for bond dealers) and now ICAI SIAB for SIAs. Assessor's Pro-Tip: On your empanelment file, attach the ICAI SIAB notification letter and cite it in the SIR signature block: 'Empanelled SIA with ICAI SIAB, URN: ___'. This pre-empts SSE listing-compliance queries at the filing desk.
